summary: By owner decision the page now shows a single headline in place of two. It counts every recommendation tracked so far, 257: the 215 key objectives and the 42 further recommendations added by reading chapters 1 to 5 in full. Foreword items remain listed and uncounted. On this basis 77 of 257 are in effect (30 percent); the earlier key-objective figure was 67 of 215 (31 percent). The side statistics and the significance-weighted share (29.3 percent) are computed from the same 257 records. The count will grow as more chapters are read in full, and chapters already read in full contribute more recommendations than the rest. No status, evidence or score on any record changed.
title: One headline over every counted recommendation
